title: SDK: Match Python residency error behavior + add region config & violation examples
author: Ibrahim Khan
description: Align TS SDK behavior with Python (redwood-sdk-python#903) for data residency enforcement errors. This adds typed exceptions for residency violation codes, preserves backwards compatibility with existing APIError handling, and adds runnable examples showing how to configure a desired region/base URL and how to handle residency violations without retries. Motivation: beta customers are hitting RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH when calling the wrong regional endpoint (SUP-3988), and today the TS SDK surfaces these as generic errors without actionable fields. Summary of changes: (1) Introduce ResidencyRegionMismatchError / ResidencyRegionNotAllowedError / ResidencyPolicyEvaluationFailedError with consistent names + fields (code, requestId, docsUrl, pinnedRegion/allowedRegions when provided). (2) Parse machine-readable error payload from gateway and attach residency-specific context to the thrown error (mirrors Python). (3) Add client option `region?: string` that (a) can set a region hint header and (b) can optionally rewrite the default base URL when using standard hosted endpoints (see docs/exmaples). (4) Add examples/residency-pinning.ts and README snippet for handling violations (do-not-retry, fix endpoint/region). Testing: unit tests with nock cover each error code mapping + fallbacks when the server omits optional fields; examples compile under `pnpm -w examples`. Rollout: no server-side dependency; safe to release as minor version; support docs can point customers to catching ResidencyRegionMismatchError and verifying base URL/region config.
commits: sdk(errors): add residency error subclasses + code mapping
sdk(client): add `region` option + region hint header
tests: cover residency code -> typed exception mapping
examples: add residency pinning + violation handling example
docs: README guidance for region config + do-not-retry semantics
review_conversation: Monica Patel: Can we match the Python class names exactly? Also ensure these extend the existing APIError so customer code catching APIError still works.

Ibrahim Khan (author): Updated to extend APIError and aligned naming to Python: ResidencyRegionMismatchError / ResidencyRegionNotAllowedError / ResidencyPolicyEvaluationFailedError. Also exported from index.ts for discoverability.

Brian Murphy: Please be careful about error.message. The gateway message can include remediation text; we should surface it, but keep structured fields stable and avoid putting raw request payload anywhere. Also include requestId when present.

Ibrahim Khan (author): Agreed. We only attach server-provided `request_id` + `docs_url` + residency fields. No request body is stored. message is passed through as-is from server; added tests verifying we don’t stringify request/response bodies.
Wei Chen: README example should show both: (1) correct regional base URL and (2) catching the typed error and printing actionable fields. Also mention that retries won’t help for REGION_MISMATCH.

Ibrahim Khan (author): Added a minimal snippet to README + a runnable example under examples/residency-pinning.ts. The example explicitly does not retry and shows how to switch base URL / region config.
Naomi Feldman: For policy eval failures, what should customers do? We should point them to Support and the docs link if present.

Ibrahim Khan (author): Added guidance in README + the thrown error includes docsUrl when provided. For RESIDENCY_POLICY_EVALUATION_FAILED we recommend retrying once only if it’s clearly transient (network/5xx), otherwise contact Support with requestId.
testing_notes: Run: `pnpm install && pnpm test` (vitest). Example: `pnpm ts-node examples/residency-pinning.ts` (requires REDWOOD_API_KEY). Mocked fixtures include payloads with `error.code` set to RESIDENCY_REGION_MISMATCH / RESIDENCY_REGION_NOT_ALLOWED / RESIDENCY_POLICY_EVALUATION_FAILED and optional residency context fields.
release_notes: TypeScript SDK now throws typed residency exceptions (e.g., ResidencyRegionMismatchError) with machine-readable fields (code, requestId, pinnedRegion/allowedRegions when provided). Added region configuration option and example for handling residency violations (fix endpoint/region; do not retry REGION_MISMATCH).
post_merge_followups: Cut minor release after redwood-docs PR lands with updated public docs links (docs_url field).
Confirm Support playbook references the TS class names (SUP-3988).
